items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. One flat-rate charge is estimated at €81 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers consumables needed for the like-for-like pipe repair. One unit is estimated at €26 gross.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) support like-for-like replacement of the failed indoor supply-pipe section. One metre is estimated at €40 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the insulation on the repaired section to its pre-loss specification. One metre is estimated at €23 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) allows necessary installer labour if it is distinct from the technician time; §7.1.8(c) bars duplicate billing. The expressly hourly entry matches Case 39's one installer hour, estimated at €80 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) allows reasonable labour to access and repair the failed pipe. Treating the nine units as hours, the close Case 39 comparison supports about €750 gross for the line.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per operation. The single flat rate is estimated at €548 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed patch. The combined patch repair is estimated at €588 gross.

Section 7.1.6 does not extend cover beyond the patch because matching paint was still available, and line 8 already covers the patch under §7.1.8(c). If the full scope were accepted, 8 m² at about €22/m² would be €176 gross.

items.description: Repaint remaining bathroom walls and ceiling
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude separate undamaged surfaces repainted only to match. If accepted, the repaint would be estimated at €420 gross for the flat-rate line.
